title: Expose a role-scoped class entry shell

evidence: Fresh disposable SvelteKit SSR/HTTP matrix: permitted Admin, Teacher, Student, and Parent all returned 200 with an empty shell and no server-resolved center/class/role context; anonymous, path mismatch, cross-center, non-member, unassigned, removed-assignment, and revoked-session cases also returned 200 rather than redirect/403.

The route server module and production build export only _createClassEntryPageLoad, not SvelteKit load; the focused test directly invokes the factory and therefore misses actual route wiring. Fresh selected regressions passed 36/36, full tests 131/131, check/build/diff gates passed, and denied-read state remained unchanged.

Fresh disposable real SvelteKit SSR/HTTP matrix passed all 13 cases: permitted Admin, Teacher, Student, and Parent returned matching 200 class/role context; anonymous/revoked returned 303 /login; path mismatch, cross-center, non-member, unassigned, and removed branches returned 403 with no protected markers and complete state equality.

Source and production build export the recognized SvelteKit load; the route-level regression imports actual load. Selected /admin, TASK-032, TASK-034, calendar, and Lesson Context regressions passed 36/36; full tests 131/131, check, build, and diff-check passed.

verify.attempt: Independent red verification after Attempt 2 functional PASS
evidence: Adversarial review found no admitted material authority/privacy break across real load wiring, request/session consistency, revocation and assignment/link removal, cross-center/non-member denial, minimized projection, state non-mutation, and owner-boundary enforcement.

Task source introduces no direct database or client permission bypass and preserves /admin, FT-003 calendar/Lesson Context, TASK-034, and downstream ownership; selected regressions passed 36/36 and full check/test/build/diff gates remained green.

verify.accepted_evidence: The explicit top-level owner accepted the independent Attempt 2 functional PASS and the required T3 semantic-pass for FT-002-AC-011 / REQ-003 / REQ-014, and requested this task-boundary sync. Current evidence is .tasks/TASK-035-T3-FT-002-W19/TASK-035-T3-FT-002-W19-S-VERIFY-RETRY-final-report-docs-02.md and .tasks/TASK-035-T3-FT-002-W19/TASK-035-T3-FT-002-W19-S-RED-VERIFY-final-report-docs-01.md.
verify.accepted_residual_risk: FT-002 and REQ-003, REQ-004, and shared REQ-014 remain planned pending the feature-level red-verify aggregate for the accepted follow-up outcomes; TASK-034, TASK-026, TASK-031, and TASK-032 remain done and unchanged.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-011 / REQ-003 / REQ-014 RED: in a fresh protected route probe, `/center/{centerId}/class/{classId}` has no role-scoped class entry shell or accepts a mismatched path/principal; GREEN: server-resolved Admin, Teacher, Student, and Parent fixtures with permitted class scope each receive the shell with their role and class context, while unauthenticated, cross-center, non-member, and removed-assignment requests fail before protected class data renders. Decisive comparison: SSR/HTTP status/body, actor role, AuthorizedClassScope center/class match, and state-before/state-after equality for denied reads; artifact under `.tasks/TASK-035-T3-FT-002-W19/` and `.protocols/TASK-035-T3-FT-002-W19/`.
purpose: Provide one protected, role-scoped class entry point that exposes only server-authorized class context for the four accepted participant roles while preserving the existing Admin management route.
success_outcome: An authenticated permitted Admin, Teacher, Student, or Parent receives a server-rendered class entry shell at `/center/{centerId}/class/{classId}` with the resolved role and class context; unauthenticated, cross-center, non-member, and removed-assignment requests are denied before protected class data renders.
anti_goals: Do not replace or redirect the existing `/admin/{centerId}` class/schedule management surface.

Do not add Lesson Context, calendar, lesson navigation, personal day data, Collaboration/Learning Progress/Financial projections, or a Teacher schedule HTTP transport; FT-003 and downstream features own those outcomes.
Do not trust client-supplied role, centerId, classId, membership, or assignment fields; do not add direct route database access, role-changing controls, persistence, or a new dependency.

stop_conditions: Stop if the accepted route cannot use the existing server-resolved Actor Context and Center & Scheduling AuthorizedClassScope without a new authorization or persistence contract.
Stop if role-specific rendering requires exposing lesson-context/calendar data, direct database reads, role mutation, or a client-owned authorization decision.
Stop if `/admin/{centerId}` management, cross-center denial, removed-assignment denial, or existing task evidence would need to change.

constraints: The route server load must resolve the request actor from the existing server session and call the existing Center & Scheduling authorized-class query; path centerId must match the returned scope centerId.
The Svelte component remains a thin transport/presentation adapter and renders only server-provided role/class context; it must not authorize, query persistence, or infer class membership.
Keep the existing `/admin/{centerId}` transport and all lesson-context/calendar ownership outside this task; no new API or cross-slice edge is introduced.
invariants: Only an actor with a server-authorized membership/assignment receives the matching center/class shell; client fields cannot widen scope.
The shell exposes role context for exactly Admin, Teacher, Student, or Parent and contains no role-changing or lesson-context/calendar capability.
Denied route reads do not render protected class data and leave persisted state unchanged; existing Admin management and done TASK-026/031/032 behavior remain intact.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-011 / REQ-003 / REQ-014 RED/GREEN: run a disposable SSR/HTTP matrix for permitted Admin, Teacher, Student, and Parent class members plus unauthenticated, cross-center, non-member, and removed-assignment requests; compare status/body, resolved role, class context, and denied-read state.

Canonical boundary proof: source review confirms the route consumes Actor Context and Center & Scheduling AuthorizedClassScope, checks path centerId/classId against server scope, and owns no direct database access or authorization logic in the component.

Regression: existing Admin center-management and TASK-032 zero-occurrence tests remain green; npm run check, npm run test, npm run build, and git diff --check pass; no `/admin/{centerId}`, lesson-context, calendar fixture, or downstream projection source changes occur.
